mapper.select: select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, ai_result, ai_risk_level, ai_sensitive_words, ai_start_time, ai_end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where work_id = #{workId} and is_deleted = 0 order by chapter_id asc, storyboard_id asc

select s.storyboard_id, s.work_id, s.chapter_id, s.chapter_title, s.content, s.word_count, s.source, s.status, s.reviewer_id, s.review_time, s.reject_reason, s.ai_result, s.ai_risk_level, s.ai_sensitive_words, s.ai_start_time, s.ai_end_time, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from sys_work_storyboard s inner join sys_work_chapter c on c.chapter_id = s.chapter_id and c.status = '0' where s.work_id = #{workId} and s.status = 'approved' and s.is_deleted = 0 order by c.chapter_no asc, s.storyboard_id asc
select count(1) from sys_work_storyboard s inner join sys_work_chapter c on c.chapter_id = s.chapter_id and c.status = '0' where s.work_id = #{workId} and s.status = 'approved' and s.is_deleted = 0

select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, ai_result, ai_risk_level, ai_sensitive_words, ai_start_time, ai_end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} and is_deleted = 0

select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, ai_result, ai_risk_level, ai_sensitive_words, ai_start_time, ai_end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where work_id = #{workId} and chapter_id = #{chapterId} limit 1
mapper.sql: select s.storyboard_id, s.work_id, s.chapter_id, s.chapter_title, s.content, s.word_count, s.source, s.status, s.reviewer_id, s.review_time, s.reject_reason, s.ai_result, s.ai_risk_level, s.ai_sensitive_words, s.ai_start_time, s.ai_end_time, s.is_deleted, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, w.title as work_title, u.nick_name as author_name from sys_work_storyboard s left join sys_work w on w.work_id = s.work_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.author_id
mapper.select:
where s.is_deleted = 0
and s.chapter_title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and w.title like concat('%', #{workTitle}, '%')
and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{authorName}, '%')
and s.status = #{status}
order by s.update_time desc, s.storyboard_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_storyboard (work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterTitle}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{source}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_work_storyboard set chapter_title = #{chapterTitle}, content = #{content}, word_count = #{wordCount}, source = #{source}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = null, review_time = null, reject_reason = null, ai_result = null, ai_risk_level = null, ai_sensitive_words = null, ai_start_time = null, ai_end_time = null, is_deleted = 0, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId}

update sys_work_storyboard set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} and is_deleted = 0 and status = 'pending'

update sys_work_storyboard set status = #{status}, ai_result = #{aiResult}, ai_risk_level = #{aiRiskLevel}, ai_sensitive_words = #{aiSensitiveWords}, ai_start_time = #{aiStartTime}, ai_end_time = #{aiEndTime}, reject_reason = case when #{status} = 'rejected' then #{rejectReason} else null end, update_time = sysdate() where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} and is_deleted = 0 and status = 'ai_reviewing'
update sys_work_storyboard set is_deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} and is_deleted = 0
